def render_header(targets: List[Path], is_system_scan: bool) ->Text:
    version = get_safety_version()
    now = datetime.datetime.now(tz=datetime.timezone.utc)
    timestamp = now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')
    
    if is_system_scan:
        scanning_text = f"Safety {version} running system scan"
    else:
        targets_str = ', '.join(t.as_posix() for t in targets)
        scanning_text = f"Safety {version} scanning {targets_str}"
    
    result = Text(f"{scanning_text}\n{timestamp}")
    return result

def print_header(console, targets: List[Path], is_system_scan: bool=False
    ) ->None:
    header = render_header(targets, is_system_scan)
    console.print(header)
